replication.target_description: Stage 1 replication of LeBoeuf & Simmons (2010), H1: Level (Category/NoBrand vs Brand) × Product Type (Utilitarian vs Symbolic) interaction in a mixed ANOVA of participant/product-type mean benefit-minus-symbolism ratings. Critical interaction explicitly identified in P12 and reported in P17.

es.quote: F(1, 555) = 10.89, p = 0.001, two-tailed, partial eta squared = 0.02

reported_success.location: P14 replication criteria; P17 Stage 1 result
reported_success.quote: There was a significant interaction of Level x Product Type on the benefit rating - symbolism rating difference scores (F(1, 555) = 10.89, p = 0.001, two-tailed, partial eta squared = 0.02; see the figure below), such that products that support symbolic attitudes are associated more utilitarian attitudes when branded, while products that support utilitarian attitudes are associated more with symbolic attitudes when branded.
